statement: Samsung and SK hynix memory stockpiles have fallen below ten days of supply as of Q3 2026.
why: Sub-ten-day memory inventory at the two largest suppliers means any demand surprise turns straight into allocation and price escalation for AI server memory.

impact.mechanism: Thin memory inventory constrains how many accelerator boards and AI servers can be assembled, since each board needs its full memory complement.

evidence.excerpt: Memory stockpiles at Samsung Electronics and SK hynix have fallen to less than 10 days of supply as of Q3 2026

confidence.basis: Secondary Korean business daily relaying a broker forecast; no company filing consulted.
